== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Found Someone You Have & Higher Ground (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1282_23</code>), showing the '''PC-E1''' text. No published image prints this version, so it was re-rendered in CardMaker (Batch B41b, Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026).

* '''Text source:''' the PC website card list (2012-12-12 to 2013-01-11).
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “During a battle at opponent's site (or your non-<> site), instead of firing one of your character weapons at a target, cause that target to be immunity to attrition -3 (or limited to immunity to attrition < 5) for remainder of turn. OR Find one of your missing characters. OR Cancel a 'react.' OR Once per game, use 1 Force to exchange a card in hand with the top most character of ability < 5 in your Lost Pile.”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 74). Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Read by eye after rendering.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
